title: 第十四章 恐惧第十五章 模板
slug: 我都成超人了灵气才复苏
content_zh:
老城区深处，某座废弃房屋。
“嗬——”
气喘吁吁的小余，小心翼翼地推开腐朽老旧的木门。
于寂静中骤然响起的吱呀，令他浑身鸡皮疙瘩炸起，动作亦随之凝滞。
他赶忙停下动作，带着惊疑不定的目光，朝四周看去。
整片老城区静静悄悄。
偶有些打呼或摩挲的动静传来，也不过是那些无处可去的流浪汉，蜷缩于民宅发出的声音。
确认没看到陈洛的身影，他才长吁一口气，将注意力再度放到眼前。
先前的动作，只将木门推开了一道不大不小的缝隙。
虽有些艰难，但也足够他挤过去。
只要躲过今晚，那个鬼一样的大学生，应该不至于在执着自己...了吧？
到时候，就先想办法到别的城市。
再不济...就报警！
小余咬着牙，内心下了极大的决心。
被治安官抓到，撑死就是送进牢里，好歹还管吃管住，只是生活无聊了些。
可那个叫陈洛的...非要把自己锁在他身边，谁知道他是不是有什么特殊的目的和爱好，
小余缓慢挤过缝隙，进入民宅内部。
映入眼帘的，是铺满灰尘的家具、和满是落叶的地面，以及边角神龛上摆放的老旧神像。
换作以往，他绝不会在这种阴气森森的地方过夜。
但经历十分钟前那场巷战，他看着这种明显不会有人靠近的地方，莫名觉得一阵心安。

想到这里。
小余转身将手搭在两边木门上，便要将其关上。
踏。
原本无比寂静的环境，突然响起极为突兀的脚步声。
“小余，你人呢？”
令人毛骨悚然的声音，从远处幽幽传来，正是陈洛。
！！！
小余推门的动作戛然而止，下意识屏住呼吸。
一股寒意从脚底升起，直窜天灵盖，令全身汗毛瞬间耸立。
不行，不能继续站在这里，会被发现的！
小余心脏狂跳，动作却愈发轻缓。
他以极为缓慢的速度，整个人趴伏到地上，避免影子漏出门外。
又用手脚支撑着身体，将屁股慢慢放到地上，确保不发出半点声音。
做完这一系列动作，他就这么靠在木门与窗户中间，整个人蜷缩起来，将脑袋埋进膝盖里。
踏。
“小余？”
content_en:
Deep in the old city, there is an abandoned house.
"Ho--"
Panting, Xiao Yu carefully pushed open the decaying old wooden door.
The sudden squeaking sound in the silence caused goosebumps all over his body and his movements froze.
He quickly stopped and looked around with doubtful eyes.
The whole old town was quiet.
Occasionally, there were sounds of snoring or rubbing, but they were just the sounds of homeless people huddled in houses with nowhere to go.
After confirming that Chen Luo was not seen, he took a long breath and turned his attention to his eyes again.
The previous action only pushed the wooden door open a small gap.
Although it was a bit difficult, it was enough for him to squeeze through.
As long as he avoids tonight, that ghost-like college student shouldn't be obsessed with him... right?
When the time comes, find a way to get to other cities first.
If it doesn't work... call the police!
Xiao Yu gritted his teeth and made a great determination in his heart.
If he was caught by the Sheriff, he would be sent to jail after being forced to death. At any rate, he would still have food and shelter, but his life would be a bit boring.
But that person named Chen Luo... insists on locking herself next to him. Who knows if he has any special purposes and hobbies?
Xiao Yu slowly squeezed through the gap and entered the house.
What came into view were the dusty furniture, the ground covered with fallen leaves, and the old statues placed on the corner shrines.
In the past, he would never spend the night in such a gloomy place.
But after experiencing the street fight ten minutes ago, he felt inexplicably at ease looking at a place where it was obvious that no one would approach.
Think of this.
Xiao Yu turned around and put his hands on the wooden doors on both sides to close them.
tread.
The originally extremely silent environment suddenly heard the sound of extremely abrupt footsteps.
"Xiao Yu, where are you?"
The creepy voice came from far away, it was Chen Luo.
! ! !
Xiao Yu's movement of pushing the door stopped suddenly, and he subconsciously held his breath.
A chill rose from the soles of his feet and went straight to the sky, causing all the hairs on his body to stand up instantly.
No, you can't continue to stand here, you will be discovered!
Xiao Yu's heart was beating wildly, but his movements became slower and slower.
He lay down on the ground at an extremely slow speed to prevent his shadow from leaking out of the door.
He supported his body with his hands and feet and slowly lowered his buttocks to the ground, making sure not to make any sound.
After completing this series of actions, he just leaned between the wooden door and the window, curled up, and buried his head in his knees.
tread.
"Xiao Yu?"
